0.original: Venat is watching you in quiet contemplation.

26.original: Report to Krile in the main hall of the Baldesion Annex.

48.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, listen to me. Our duty now is not to denounce Hermes for his misguided determination, or to convince Emet-Selch and Hythlodaeus that they have been deceived.

49.original: No, we must instead ensure that the experiences Hermes sought to expunge are preserved.

50.original: What remains in our memories alone will be our weapon against the Final Days.

51.original: You must fight this battle in your age, and I in mine...

52.original: Come, let us walk together once more. I will see you to the doors of Propylaion.

53.original: Your time in this age is drawing to an end.

54.original: Upon speaking to Venat, several cutscenes will play in sequence.

55.original: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.

57.original: Continue with the main scenario quest?

58.original: You've a knack for turning up <hex:021A020203>exactly<hex:021A020103> when needed, and this is no exception!

60.original: I'd heard you were off in the First as part of our efforts to investigate the Final Days.

61.original: Well, as so often seems to be the case, while you were away, we've had some few developments...

62.original: ...Which we can discuss in just a moment. For now, however, I cannot tell you how wonderful it is to have you back!
